allowedWork: Revise only the existing unreviewed integration power-rule asset to the approved exact three-state sequence.
Add exact integration semantics, lineage, assumptions, bounded typed gaps, and governed construction evidence.
Extract a renderer-owned outline, salience-only, or none operator-scope policy while preserving the derivative outline.
Add one integration-specific presentation plan and the smallest additive evaluation-cohort seam needed for two compiler-certified ink-knot groups.
Add scoped tests, a stable visual command, Catalogue lifecycle evidence, generated freshness, and project closeout evidence.
disallowedWork: Do not implement arbitrary exponents, a general integration solver, definite integrals, substitution, area, or Fundamental Theorem choreography.
Do not add a sum-rule caller, promote the integration family, expand the live-model benchmark, or generalize catalogue-wide operator styling.
Do not retune or change the approved derivative choreography, scope outline, semantics, timings, selectors, or route.
Do not give models or renderers mathematical, correspondence, timing, geometry, or fallback authority.
Do not modify protected economics files, the broad editor-animation-visuals browser test, gallery behavior, Scheme, or the global application theme.
goal: Ship one governed three-state indefinite-integration power-rule exemplar with exact rational truth, renderer-owned salience-only operator scope, two certified ink-knot evaluations, canonical Catalogue hosting, and a mandatory human visual checkpoint.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence; stop at slice 18 for explicit human visual approval and never stage protected user files.
stopConditions: Stop at slice 18 for human visual review before slices 19 and 20.
Stop on semantic truth, exact rational, correspondence, or lineage failures that cannot be repaired inside the current slice.
Stop if dual evaluation requires a universal evaluation graph or breaks singular existing callers.
Stop on derivative visual, lifecycle, or semantic drift.
Stop before arbitrary exponents, general integration, definite integration, substitution, area, Fundamental Theorem choreography, a sum-rule caller, promotion, or live-model expansion.
Stop before touching protected user files, gallery behavior, Scheme, or global theme behavior.
Stop when subjective visual judgment is required.

slices.title: Baseline-and-protected-path-fence
slices.summary: Established a scoped integration test command, documented the canonical host and pre-change behavior, fenced derivative and evaluation baselines, and preserved every protected user path; all three baselines pass.

slices.title: Exact-rational-canonical-sample
slices.summary: The existing integration asset now derives its coefficient through normalized exact-rational arithmetic and carries exact 1/3 metadata; its canonical raw states are integral x squared, x to 2+1 over 2+1 plus C, and x cubed over 3 plus C. Scoped tests and full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Integration-semantic-selector-roles
slices.summary: Declared a closed renderer-neutral role vocabulary for all three states, stable semantic groups for the integrand, dx binding, both successor expressions, and exact quotients, plus constraints for exponent provenance and required plus C. Scoped tests and full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Integration-correspondence-and-lineage
slices.summary: Compiled total and rewind-safe expansion and resolution correspondence with valid semantic lineage graphs: one exponent split supplies both successors, each successor merges into its own 3, and plus C persists from the first rewritten state. Scoped tests and full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Bounded-integration-case-ledger
slices.summary: Added a frozen integration case ledger with one exemplar candidate and typed repair gaps for n=-1, symbolic exponents, definite bounds, substitution, area, FTC, and unbound edits. Each gap names a unique repair target and cannot claim an executable target. Scoped tests and full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Governed-construction-binding
slices.summary: Bound the canonical monic-quadratic fixture through the single public governed construction request and compiler, with exact object and operation closure and compiler-owned laws, roles, and lineage. Unsupported cases now return their ledger repair before any request exists. Scoped tests, full typecheck, and architecture gates pass.

slices.title: Discovery-and-coverage-projections
slices.summary: Projected the exact Catalogue asset as Exemplar, registered the bounded eight-case integration ledger, regenerated canonical manifests and coverage, and preserved missing family-promotion and general-generation evidence.

slices.title: Renderer-owned-operator-scope-policy
slices.summary: Added a renderer-owned closed scope-treatment vocabulary and fail-closed registry, kept derivative on outline, assigned integration salience-only, and routed the existing derivative trace through the policy without moving semantic or geometry authority.

slices.title: Derivative-outline-preservation-pressure
slices.summary: Added an executable assertion that the derivative transition resolves the outline policy and retains the accepted scope trace role and solid border. Four Chromium lifecycle checks, thirty-five focused tests, and nine inspected visual frames preserve the route, timings, selectors, choreography, and Native KaTeX ownership.

slices.title: Exact-selector-annotated-integration-KaTeX
slices.summary: Bound the canonical monic fixture to the declared roles and lineage, replaced legacy coefficient-first selectors with exact source, fraction, successor, denominator, and plus-C selectors, added trusted KaTeX group annotations for integrand, dx, quotient, and constant, and regenerated endpoint fingerprints. Scoped tests, MathML checks, typecheck, and architecture gates pass.

slices.title: Integration-first-transition-plan
slices.summary: Compiled the governed first transition into semantic salience, opacity-only operator withdrawal, persistent base, exponent fan-out, and four typed introductions. Rewrite progress begins only after the operator exits, with deterministic seek, reverse, and interruption and no outline or geometry policy in the semantic plan.

slices.title: Native-KaTeX-integration-material-transit
slices.summary: Bound the integration choreography to the existing Native KaTeX scene compositor: the base persists, one exponent splits to two governed targets, unmatched operator paint eliminates, and fraction, both increments, connector, and constant introduce. A stable Chromium canary certifies realized-paint continuity, exclusive source/material/target ownership, exact native settlement, and no new paint system or promotion.

slices.title: Two-cohort-evaluation-certification
slices.summary: Certified exactly two disjoint integration successor cohorts from correspondence and endpoint metadata: numerator 2,+,1 to 3 and denominator 2,+,1 to 3. Added semantic operator roles, fail-closed plural certification, and exact selector metadata while leaving the singular compiler and derivative callers unchanged; no general graph, fallback, family promotion, or arbitrary exponent support was added.

slices.title: Antiderivative-governance-presentation-payload
slices.summary: Added a dedicated antiderivative migration selected by generic dispatch. The parent resolution remains one transformation and one clocked transition, while an antiderivative-specific semantic-only payload carries exactly two registry-authorized, review-stage contributor-fusion certificates. Singular evaluation fields stay empty for this compound transition; existing singular callers and the derivative route remain unchanged.

slices.title: Dual-ink-knot-native-mount
slices.summary: Extended the existing certified Native KaTeX contributor-fusion primitive with certificate-owned cohort scoping and a tuple wrapper that applies one base clock and lifecycle exactly once. Added an antiderivative mount that builds eight live material owners from the two payload certificates, keeps the numerator and denominator knots independent, preserves source and target native settlement, and uses the shared salience resolver. A stable Chromium canary proves realized paint ownership, kernel legibility state, spatial separation, and deterministic settlement; Catalogue wiring remains for s16.

slices.title: Canonical-Catalogue-lifecycle
slices.summary: Connected the governed integration first transit and dual certified evaluation cohorts to the existing Catalogue equation stage. The host now restores native endpoint paint before compositor ownership, applies salience-only operator attention with opacity withdrawal, realizes both 2+1 to 3 ink knots under one resolution clock, exposes exact native endpoints, retires on scene, measurement, and surface lifecycle boundaries, and reports a typed runtime repair gap instead of generic fallback. Stable Chromium checks cover URL restoration, seek, rewind, theme response, reduced motion, static accessibility truth, and derivative preservation.

slices.title: Integration-visual-review-sheet
slices.summary: Added a stable scoped visual command that captures eight deterministic Catalogue states spanning native source, salience-only scope, material rewrite, expanded fraction with persistent +C, both ink-knot phases, native target, and narrow light fit. The command emits a disposable PNG contact sheet, HTML review page, and machine-readable semantic manifest without adding permanent gallery chrome or claiming visual certification.
